hooks.command: jq -r ".tool_input.command // empty" | grep -Eq "commit --amend|pkill -f|checkout -- " && { echo "BLOCKED: dangerous git/proc command (commit --amend, pkill -f, checkout --) — refused by the PreToolUse guard in .claude/settings.json" >&2; exit 2; } || exit 0
jq -r ".tool_input.file_path // empty" | { read -r f; [ -n "$f" ] || exit 0; case "$f" in *.py|*.pyi) ;; *) exit 0 ;; esac; ruff format "$f" 2>/dev/null; ruff check --select E9,F63,F7,F82 "$f"; }
